cards.title: Investigate Negative Stock Quantity in products.stock_quantity
cards.rationale: Negative stock quantities were detected in the `products` table. This indicates a data integrity issue that requires investigation to determine the root cause and appropriate corrective action. The provided SQL identifies the affected records.
cards.sql: SELECT product_id, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 0;

cards.title: Investigate Inconsistent Shipped and Delivered Dates in Shipments
cards.rationale: The `shipments` table contains records where the `delivered_date` is earlier than the `shipped_date`, indicating a temporal ordering inconsistency. This suggests a data quality issue that requires investigation into data ingestion or application logic. The provided SQL identifies the inconsistent records.
cards.sql: SELECT shipment_id, shipped_date, delivered_date FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date < shipped_date;

cards.title: Investigate Temporal Inconsistency in orders.order_date
cards.rationale: Orders exist with an order_date earlier than the associated customer's created_at date. This temporal inconsistency suggests a data quality issue that requires investigation. The provided SQL identifies the inconsistent records.
cards.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.created_at AS customer_created_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date < c.created_at;

evidence_payload.description: Orders exist with an order_date earlier than the associated customer's created_at date.
